name: Christmas & Thanksgiving Honey-Baked Spiral Sliced Glazed Ham
brandOrRestaurant: Holiday Table / The Honey Baked Ham Co. / Costco Kirkland Spiral Ham
whyItWorks: Tender spiral-sliced cured ham with a sweet honey-brown-sugar glaze has zero fiber, zero dairy, and zero citrus—great warm at dinner or cold on leftover Hawaiian roll sliders.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Choose lean center-cut slices and pair with mashed potatoes and soft dinner rolls.
watchOuts: Verify no orange juice or pineapple-citrus glaze was used if homemade
